name: Testimonial Block
author: WPDeveloper

sections.description:
Want to display testimonials on your website & gain instant credibility? Use this Testimonial block within Gutenberg & present the reviews of your happy customers as social proof.

Using this, it will take you a few minutes to create stunning Testimonial sections within WordPress Block Editor and improve the conversion rates.

Completely Customizable: You can customize the with image, size, color, content etc. to make it suitable for your website.

Super Light-weight: No extra resources used and it’s highly optimized for super fast loading & instant Live editing.

External services

This plugin connects to Google Fonts to load the fonts you pick in a Testimonial block’s typography settings.

  • What it is used for: displaying the selected font on the front end of your site.
  • When data is sent: on every front-end page that contains a Testimonial block whose typography uses a font family other than Default or a system font (Arial, Tahoma, Verdana, Helvetica, Times New Roman, Trebuchet MS, Georgia).
  • What is sent: the visitor’s browser requests the stylesheet from fonts.googleapis.com and the font files from fonts.gstatic.com, so Google receives the visitor’s IP address, user agent and the referring page, together with the requested font family names.

The service is provided by Google: Terms of Service, Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
Modern Way:

  1. Go to the WordPress Block/Gutenberg Editor
  2. Search For “Testimonial”.
  3. Install in 1-click

Old Way:

  1. Upload testimonial-wp-block to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Follow the Documentation
sections.faq:
Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, it will work with any standard WordPress theme.
